settings.question: Need an app or subscription?
settings.answer: Neither. Tap with an NFC-enabled phone and internet access. Daily content is free.

settings.question: Will it work with my phone?
settings.answer: iPhone XS or newer and most NFC-enabled Android phones work. Older iPhones may need the NFC reader. Contact us if unsure.

settings.question: What size—and when will it arrive?
settings.answer: Measure your wrist; use the size guide above. In stock: typically 5–10 U.S. business days. Preorder estimates appear by your selection; mixed orders ship together.
